Verify Now Blog > Meet PCBWay at Electronica 2026 in Munich, Germany Meet PCBWay at Electronica 2026 in Munich, Germany by: Mila Oct 16,2026 <dynamic-value> <dynamic-value> Posted in News PCBWay is excited to announce our participation in Electronica 2026, one of the leading international trade fairs for the electronics industry. Join us in Munich, Germany, from November 10 to 13, 2026, to explore PCB manufacturing, electronic assembly, and engineering solutions for your projects. Visit PCBWay at Hall A1 – Booth 559 We welcome engineers, designers, businesses, and electronics enthusiasts to visit our booth and learn more about PCBWay's services. Whether you are developing a new electronic product, building prototypes, or preparing for production, our team looks forward to discussing your project requirements and exploring how we can support your ideas. Event Details Event: Electronica 2026 Date: November 10–13, 2026 Location: Messe München, Munich, Germany PCBWay Booth: Hall A1 – 559 Discover PCBWay's Services PCBWay provides a wide range of manufacturing and engineering services to support electronic product development, from initial concepts and prototypes to production. PCB Manufacturing: Custom printed circuit boards in various specifications, including multilayer, HDI, flexible, and rigid-flex PCBs. PCB Assembly: Turnkey and partial PCB assembly services, including component sourcing, SMT assembly, through-hole assembly, and functional testing. PCB Design Service: Professional schematic design, PCB layout, and complete electronic product development support. CNC Machining and Sheet Metal Fabrication: Custom mechanical parts and enclosures for electronic devices, prototypes, and production applications. 3D Printing and Injection Molding: Rapid prototyping and custom plastic parts to help transform product concepts into physical components. By bringing these capabilities together, PCBWay helps customers simplify their development process and coordinate multiple manufacturing needs through one partner. Electronica brings together professionals from across the electronics industry, providing an opportunity to exchange ideas, explore new technologies, and build valuable connections. If you are attending Electronica 2026, stop by the PCBWay booth at Hall A1 – 559. We look forward to meeting you in Munich and discussing how PCBWay can help bring your electronic projects to life. See you at Electronica 2026 ! Enter the year of your birth and check your Chinese Zodiac. Join us Wanna be a dedicated PCBWay writer? We definately look forward to having you with us.
